resources.string: They are used whenever the game runs on MobileGlues, also from Performance Mode. The launcher writes them into MobileGlues\' config file at every launch, so the settings inside the MobileGlues app are not used here. A change applies the next time the game starts.
OpenGL version shown to the game
What MobileGlues tells the game. Your phone\'s own driver (OpenGL ES) still does the real work, and its level can\'t be raised.
ANGLE runs OpenGL ES on top of Vulkan. MobileGlues only supports it on some Adreno phones; forcing it on other phones can break the game.
Whether MobileGlues hides OpenGL errors from the game. Hiding them can avoid some crashes, but it also hides real problems.
Let the game use compute shaders. Only a few mods need them. Off by default.
Let the game ask the GPU how long its work takes. Some mods and profilers use this. On by default.
Offer the newer, leaner OpenGL calls known as direct state access. On by default.
MobileGlues remembers the shaders it has already translated, so later launches do not translate them again. Off means no cache.
A workaround for depth glitches that can show up with ANGLE. It only matters while ANGLE is on.
Draws the game smaller and upscales it with AMD FSR 1. Experimental in MobileGlues, and it changes the render resolution, so it stays off unless you choose it.
Shows made-up names instead of \"MobileGlues\" and hides its extra extensions, for mods that refuse to run on it. The version text gets random letters, so leave it off unless a mod needs it.

How MobileGlues draws many pieces of terrain at once. Type method names, best first, separated by commas: native, multiindirect, multibasevertex, multiarrays, indirect, basevertex, unroll, compute. Leave it empty for MobileGlues\' automatic choice. Unknown names are dropped.
Overrides the order above for this call only. Names that apply here: unroll, multiarrays, multiindirect. Leave empty to use the order above.
Overrides the order above for this call only. Names that apply here: unroll, indirect, multiindirect, multibasevertex, multiarrays. Leave empty to use the order above.
Overrides the order above for this call only. Names that apply here: unroll, basevertex, indirect, multiindirect, multibasevertex, compute. Leave empty to use the order above.
Overrides the order above for this call only. Names that apply here: indirect, multiindirect. Leave empty to use the order above.
Overrides the order above for this call only. Names that apply here: indirect, multiindirect. Leave empty to use the order above.
Puts every MobileGlues setting back to its default.
Every MobileGlues setting above goes back to its default.
